verdict.rationale: Open-source licensing is a fair question for a SaaS productivity product, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence that Notion's own application source is available under an open license. The only open-source mention is the separate notion-mcp-server package, a companion tool rather than the product's source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
